title: Europe Spent 1,000 Years Copying This Cup, Fired at 1,300°C | China Travel Expert
description:
Why did Europe spend a thousand years failing to copy a Chinese cup?

China was firing true porcelain at around 1,300°C long before anyone else could — thin, white, and so hard it rings like a bell. The recipe was guarded for centuries; Europe only made its own hard-paste porcelain at Meissen in 1708. The English word "china" still means the ware itself.

🧭 Expert Tip: In Jingdezhen, the old porcelain capital, watch a master throw and glaze a piece before you buy — you will never look at a teacup the same way.

一只瓷杯，让欧洲追了上千年。
